## Per list, what already existing would mean

A list reported as already existing is NOT a no-op. An internal name is
fixed at creation and can never be changed, so a list somebody made by
hand will have `Installation ID` where every formula expects
`Installation_x0020_ID`, and every read returns blank rather than
erroring. Check it column by column against
`docs/SHAREPOINT_SCHEMA_MANIFEST.md` before continuing.
